review.notes: All eight unweighted domains and their Enterprise-aware subobjectives are mapped to server, monitoring, security, availability, HSM, performance, access, and Agent operations plus eight independent labs. The September 7 recheck confirmed the vendor rename to Vault Operations Advanced and the new canonical preparation URLs while all 130 compared objective lines remained unchanged. All 22 cited sources are first-party and reachable. Version, edition, HCP responsibility, seal, replication, metric, licensing, and exam-environment behavior are marked for current verification.

findings.title: Advanced version baseline was unstated
findings.recommendation: Add baseline and separate current 2.x product documentation.
findings.resolution: Add baseline and separate current 2.x product documentation.

findings.title: Rename announcement now available
findings.evidence: Shared notice names Vault and Terraform, fall 2026, unchanged content/format.
findings.recommendation: Replace old concern while retaining stable internal code.
findings.resolution: Replace old concern while retaining stable internal code.

findings.title: Audit guarantee and evidence boundaries incomplete
findings.evidence: Delivery is guaranteed to at least one enabled destination; HMAC and disabled-device limits matter.
findings.recommendation: Explain independent devices, correlated records, type-preserving deduplication and hashing scope.
findings.resolution: Explain independent devices, correlated records, type-preserving deduplication and hashing scope.

findings.title: Wrapped sink shorthand hid renewal ownership
findings.evidence: Method wrapping hides the token from auto-auth; sink wrapping permits lifecycle management with different creation-path meaning.
findings.recommendation: Separate methods and repair Lab 7 expectations.
findings.resolution: Separate methods and repair Lab 7 expectations.

findings.title: Seal-wrap description was unnecessarily HSM-only
findings.evidence: Current reference supports seals including KMS while objective 5b specifies PKCS#11.
findings.recommendation: Retain objective focus and label broader product behavior and runtime dependency.
findings.resolution: Retain objective focus and label broader product behavior and runtime dependency.

blog_intake.value: Managed versus self-managed recovery responsibility worksheet.
blog_intake.limits: Announcement-time public preview; current entitlement and GA not established; no service execution.

local_validation.mode: isolated local dev server; in-memory; HTTP loopback; synthetic training values
assertions: Dev server initialized, unsealed and active
Nonroot read denied before policy repair
Same nonroot token reads after narrow policy repair
Revoked token cannot read previously permitted path
Denied and successful reads have paired audit records
Audit protects the synthetic string value with HMAC
Server stopped and loopback listener closed
local_validation.lab: Lab 3 partial: nonroot denial, narrow policy repair, audit request/response correlation, revocation
limits: No production hardening, TLS, Raft cluster, snapshot, Enterprise, HSM, replication, Sentinel, Agent or Kubernetes execution.
Dev mode is intentionally not a production configuration.
Tokens and raw audit values are excluded from committed evidence.
local_validation.cleanup: Disposable token revoked, synthetic KV metadata and policy deleted, server stopped and listener closed.

limitations: Same-context AI review; independent human review pending.
Only local Vault 1.16.3 dev-server ACL/audit portion of Lab 3 executed; no production, TLS, Raft, HSM, Agent, Kubernetes, Enterprise or HCP testing.
HCP cluster DR article is a June public-preview announcement; web retrieval readable but direct HTTP blocked; no GA or current entitlement claim.
No exact mapped third-party Advanced course with verified runtime accepted.

validation.execution_boundary: Eight assertions across 13 API requests on an isolated local Vault 1.16.3 dev server; only the ACL/audit portion of Lab 3 executed. No production or Enterprise execution.
